name: Common Magic Crystal
description: A dull shard of magic. The Guild buys every one.

name: Rare Magic Crystal
description: It hums when you hold it close.

name: Epic Magic Crystal
description: Warm to the touch, and heavier than it looks.

name: Legendary Magic Crystal
description: Light pours out of it like water.

name: Slime Gel
description: Sticky, cool and faintly sweet. Alchemists use it as a base.

name: Slime Core
description: The hard heart of a slime. It still twitches.

name: Prismatic Gel
description: Gel from a rare slime. It shifts colour in the light.

name: Goblin Tooth
description: Yellow and crooked. The Guild counts them as proof of a bounty.

name: Tattered Cloth
description: A rag that was once somebody's shirt.

name: Leather Scrap
description: Stitched together from stolen boots and belts.

name: Iron Scrap
description: Bent nails and broken studs. A smith can melt it down.

name: Brute Tusk
description: A tusk as long as a hand, chipped from fights.

name: Crude Arrows
description: Bent shafts with stone heads. Fletchers buy them for the heads.

name: Hawk Feather
description: A long barred feather that sharpshooters wear for luck.

name: Ember Shard
description: A splinter of the shaman's fire, still glowing.

name: Shaman's Totem
description: Bones and beads on a string. Something inside it whispers.

name: Cowhide
description: A thick spotted hide. Tanners pay well for it.

name: Goat Horn
description: A ridged, curling horn.

name: Deer Hide
description: Soft and light, good for gloves.

name: Antler
description: A branching antler, polished by the forest.

name: Wool
description: A soft white tuft. It smells of meadow.

name: Boar Tusk
description: Curved and sharp. It made a fine weapon for the boar.

name: Boar Hide
description: Bristly and tough.

name: Orc Tusk
description: Yellowed, chipped, and as long as a finger.

name: Wolf Pelt
description: Thick grey fur, warm through the worst winter.

name: Wolf Fang
description: Long, curved and still sharp.

name: Feather
description: A small white feather. Good for arrows and pillows.

name: Raw Steak
description: A thick cut of beef. Better cooked, but it fills you up.

name: Goat Meat
description: Lean and a little tough.

name: Venison
description: Dark, rich deer meat.

name: Mutton
description: Fatty and filling.

name: Boar Meat
description: Gamey and strong.

name: Raw Chicken
description: A plucked bird. Elda would know a recipe.

name: Egg
description: Still warm.

name: Minor Healing Potion
description: A small red draught. Heals 40 health at once.

name: Healing Potion
description: A full flask of the alchemist's best. Heals 100 health at once.

name: Wooden Sword
description: A training blade. It still hurts.

name: Rusty Dagger
description: A goblin's knife. Short, quick and dirty.

name: Spiked Club
description: A log with nails in it. Subtle it is not.

name: Goblin Shortbow
description: Small, springy and strung with gut.

name: Hunter's Longbow
description: Stolen from a hunter long ago and cared for better than its owner did.

name: Bone Staff
description: A staff topped with a small skull. Its eye sockets glow faintly.

name: Archer's Hood
description: A green hood that hides the face.

name: Mask of Embers
description: A skull mask that smells of smoke. The shaman never took it off.

name: Hide Vest
description: Rough leather plates laced over a brute's chest.

name: Boarhide Boots
description: Bristly boots that keep your feet dry.

name: Jelly Ring
description: A ring of hardened slime. It wobbles when you walk.

name: Goblin Cap
description: A pointed leather cap with a notch cut for an ear.

name: Dented Iron Helm
description: Too big for a goblin, which is why the brute wore it.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: Soft deer leather, stitched by someone who knew how.

name: Patched Trousers
description: More patch than trouser, but warm.

name: Chain Leggings
description: Rusted rings that still turn a blade.

name: Twin Daggers
description: A matched pair, quick in both hands.
